subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ Which parameter should be set to the (tilemap location of ((sprite) row))?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Should the (startingColumn) variable be placed in the col or row parameter?


Solution: 

The bubbles in the col and row parameters of the [set tile at location] block should be swapped.
steps.instructions:
When the A button is pressed, the bridge tiles are placed in the wrong location!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the user inputted number of bridge tiles replace the black placeholder tiles, when the A button is pressed.

subgroups.title: Debugging Tilemap Location Blocks and Operators
subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project asks the user for a number of tiles, which then connect to existing bridge tiles on the tilemap.

validationItems.text: col and row parameters are swapped in [set tile at location] block.
validationItems.failureText: Check the parameters in the [set tile at location] block.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ In the (tilemap location of ((sprite) column)) blocks, should the direction be set to column or row?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓How should the row parameter be determined in the [set tile at location] and [set wall at] blocks?


Solution: 

The (tilemap location of ((sprite) column)) should be changed to (tilemap location of ((sprite) row)) in both [set tile at location] and [set wall at] blocks.
steps.instructions:
After the user inputs the number of bridge tiles, they appear below the Player sprite.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the bridge tiles connect and build onto the existing bridge on the tilemap.

Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project asks the user for a number of tiles, which then connect to existing bridge tiles on the tilemap.

steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What number does the [for index] loop start counting at?


Solution: 

The (0+0) operator should be duplicated and added to the parameter of the [for index] loop. The (bridgeLength) variable should be placed in the left parameter and the operation should be updated to (-).
steps.instructions:
When the user inputs the number of bridge tiles, the project adds one more tile to the bridge than the value entered.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the project places the exact number of tiles inputted by the user.
